exposure: Dietary pattern (e.g., high protein diet with non-alcoholic beverage)
cohort: The study investigated 1,339 mothers who had hospital deliveries in Ibadan, Nigeria, as part of the Ibadan Pregnancy Cohort Study (IbPCS).
finding: The study identified infant sex, emergency caesarean section, and history of hypertension in pregnancy as factors associated with low birth weight, while poverty, history of stillbirth, and antepartum depression were linked to preterm birth, with most maternal lifestyle factors (except for a high protein dietary pattern reducing preterm birth risk) showing no significant association with LBW and birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was found to be associated with an increased risk of low birth weight.
